claim: The Villerest Un sightseeing boat operates April 1–October 31 with a 1h cruise to St-Jean-St-Maurice at 3pm daily except Wed/Sun, and from May to end of August a 3h30 cruise to Château de la Roche at 9am on Wed/Sun, all by reservation.
quote: From April 1 to October 31, there is a 1 hour walk to St-Jean-St-Maurice-sur-Loire, with departure at 3 p.m. every day except Wednesdays and Sundays. From May to the end of August on Wednesdays and Sundays: 3h30 walk to the Château de la Roche at 9 a.m. All walks are by reservation.

claim: Château de la Roche at Saint-Priest-la-Roche is open Wed–Fri and weekends 10:00–12:30 and 14:00–18:30 from 4 April through 3 July 2026, with full price 8€ / reduced 6€ / under-6 free.
quote: From 04/04 to 03/07/2026 on Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and weekends between 10 am and 12.30 pm and between 2 pm and 6.30 pm. Open exceptionally on 06/04, 01/05, 08/05, 14/05 and 25/05. Full price: 8 € | Reduced price: 6 €

claim: The Roanne-Iguerande section of the Véloire greenway is 24 km of fully paved cycle path with minimal elevation (259–276m), rated suitable for all cyclists and family-friendly with picnic tables along the route.
quote: Length: 24 km. Surface: Entirely smooth cycle path (100%). Elevation: Minimal - 11m ascents, 0m descents; ranges from 259m to 276m. Difficulty: Suitable for all cyclists... 'a stage suitable for all cyclists' with 'many picnic tables and loungers'

claim: The Roanne-Digoin canal is 56 km long with ten locks, and the towpath hosts a 25 km greenway from the Port of Roanne to Charlieu via Briennon — marked, accessible for reduced mobility, and electric bikes are rentable at the harbour master's office.
quote: The canal is 56 kilometres long and has ten locks... 25 secure and marked kilometers await cyclists, hikers and Sunday strollers... This greenway also allows people with reduced mobility, rollerblading or running enthusiasts... Electric bike rentals are available at the harbor master's office

claim: Côte Roannaise day-hike options include the easy 9 km Monts de la Madeleine loop from Villemontais (+349m) and the 4–7 km easy-to-moderate Gorge du Désert circuit from Saint-Alban-les-Eaux, plus a 17.9 km easy Moulins Chérier loop.
quote: Grande boucle des Moulins Chérier | 17.92 km | +517 m | Easy (Cherier). Les Monts de la Madeleine (Villemontais) | 9.04 km | +349 m | Easy. Gorge du Désert | 4.37–6.96 km | +194–360 m | Easy–Moderate (Saint-Alban-les-Eaux)

claim: The Côte Roannaise vineyard spans about 215 hectares on a 20 km terraced hillside, AOC since 1994, with around thirty winegrowers across roughly ten villages including Renaison and Saint-Haon-le-Châtel.
quote: The Côte Roannaise vineyard radiates over a 20-kilometer-long, terraced hillside, and the 215 hectares of the Côte Roannaise vineyard are located in the north of the Loire department and are recognized as an AOC since 1994, with around thirty winegrowers on more than 200 hectares and around ten villages.

claim: The Côte Roannaise wine route runs about 55 km from La Pacaudière in the north to Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire, crossing 12 appellation communes and doable as a one-day scenic drive.
quote: The wine route stretches from La Pacaudière in the north to Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire, south of Roanne, a distance of approximately 55 km, and this route crosses 12 communes within the appellation. You can explore this exceptional itinerary, combining nature, heritage, and gastronomy, in one day.

claim: Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire, a Village of Character 15 km from Roanne, has a 17 m medieval keep with 360° views over the dam and a Romanesque church with listed 12th-century pilgrim frescoes.
quote: The keep called Tour de Saint-Maurice is a vestige of the medieval past that dominates the village from its 17 meters and offers a 360° panorama over the waters of the dam... renovated Romanesque church with its chancel completely covered with listed 12th century frescoes showing Santiago de Compostela pilgrim frescoes

claim: The free Belvédère de Commelle-Vernay site offers views over the dam, a two-metre two-sided sundial, an orientation table, and a picnic area, and serves as the boarding station for the Loire tourist activity.
quote: The site offers magnificent views of the dam, the village of Villerest, the church and the Vernay bridge. On this site there is a gigantic two-sided sundial, a vertical disc two meters in diameter... The site features an orientation table, the Loire tourist train station, and a picnic area.

claim: Belvédère Aventures in Commelle-Vernay (10 min from Roanne) replaces the old tourist train with electric-assist 4-seater railbikes covering a 6.8 km round-trip in 1h30, with 2026 departures from 4 April at 10:00, 11:30, 14:00, 15:30; reservation mandatory.
quote: Situated in Commelle-Vernay, approximately 10 minutes from Roanne... 6,8 km A/R s'effectue en 1H30 en mode balade... For the 2026 season starting April 4th, departures occur at 10:00, 11:30, 14:00, and 15:30... LA RESERVATION EST INDISPENSABLE!

claim: Roanne in late May/early June averages highs around 23°C with lows around 12°C, ~15.7 hours of daylight in June, ~33% chance of rain on a given June day — generally good for hiking, cycling and boating.
quote: the weather in Roanne in June is mildly cool and breezy, with average highs of 74°F (23°C) and lows of 53°F (12°C)... In Roanne in June, there's a 33% chance of rain on an average day... The average day in Roanne during June has 15.7 hours of daylight

claim: Port de la Caille at Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire is a pleasure port on the Villerest dam with sailing, fishing and water-launching services, open seasonally 15 March – 30 October.
quote: The Port de la Caille is a pleasure port on the Villerest Dam, located in Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire... welcomes water sports, fishing and sailing enthusiasts with warmth and conviviality for a season from March 15 to October 30.
